item.title: Suspect wanted in Puyallup armed bank robbery
item.description: Police are asking for the public's help in identifying the suspect in an armed bank robbery in Puyallup.

item.title: Starbucks announces new slate of Seattle location closures
item.description: Starbucks representatives have announced five locations in the Seattle area will be shut down. The Starbucks Workers United union says they have filed an unfair labor practice charge.

item.title: Seattle City Council to vote on immigration detention center moratorium
item.description: The Seattle City Council is set to vote Tuesday on emergency legislation that would temporarily block new immigration detention centers from opening in the city.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks to re-sign WR Rashid Shaheed on 3-year, $51 million deal
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks are expected to re-sign wide receiver Rashid Shaheed to a three-year, $51 million deal.

item.title: Search is on for suspect in Parkland, WA teen shooting
item.description: Investigators are looking for the person who shot and killed an 18-year-old in Pierce County.

item.title: Late-season snowstorm brings hope to struggling Cascade ski towns
item.description: Forecasters are calling for several feet of snow in the Cascades this week, a sharp shift from earlier conditions that left skiers and businesses discouraged.

item.title: Ballard, WA cafe owners camping in business overnights to stop copper thieves
item.description: Cafe owners in Ballard tell FOX 13 they are forced to camp out overnight at their business to stop recurring copper thefts. The National Nordic Museum faces similar troubles.

item.title: No pay for TSA workers, but SEA wait times remain short
item.description: As TSA workers continue to work without pay, some major hubs are reporting hours-long security wait times. However, that isn't quite the case in Seattle.

item.title: Bobby McMann hoping to bring speed, physicality to Seattle Kraken lineup
item.description: Bobby McMann took the ice for the Seattle Kraken in practice on Monday for the first time since being traded by the Toronto Maple Leafs in the closing minutes before Friday's NHL trade deadline.

item.title: Skykomish, WA parents demand answers after teacher arrested for child rape
item.description: Parents in the Skykomish School District are demanding answers after a teacher was arrested for investigation of child rape.
